claim: The maximum compute capacity an account can use concurrently in AWS Glue is 1,000 DPUs in us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2, ap-northeast-1, ap-southeast-2 and eu-west-1, and 500 DPUs in each of the other supported Regions; the quota is adjustable.
question: AWS Glue: how many DPUs can an account use at one time (Max task DPUs per account)?

qualifiers.scope: DPUs used concurrently, per Region, per account
